questions.stemHtml: A 63-year-old woman presented with low back pain and back stiffness. An X-ray spine was done which is shown below. Which of the following statements is true regarding the condition she is suffering from?

options.text: It does not require medical intervention

options.label: B
options.text: Lateral curve 10 degrees is seen in this condition

options.label: C
